name: All in One – AI Product Manager for WooCommerce
author: Jcodex

sections.description:
All in One – AI Product Manager for WooCommerce doesn’t just write content — it tells you what’s actually wrong with each product first. Open any product, click Check, and get a free Product Health Score out of 100, broken down across content, SEO, images, and conversion. Then generate descriptions, short descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, features, benefits, and product images right inside the WooCommerce product editor.

No API key. No OpenAI account. Type a few product details, click Generate, and review the result before you publish. SEO titles and meta descriptions can also be saved to the plugin’s built-in SEO fields when no supported SEO plugin is installed.

Running an online shop with hundreds of products? The built-in All Products Scanner checks every product in one scan and reports which ones are missing titles, descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, images, image alt text, or FAQs — and gives each product a Health Score — so you know where to focus.

Whether you run a WooCommerce store, a dropshipping business, a print-on-demand shop, or manage client stores as an agency, this plugin cuts product listing time from hours to minutes. Free generations refresh every month. It is not a one-time trial.

🚀 Why Store Owners Choose This Plugin

Most WooCommerce stores lose hours writing listings by hand, or paste supplier copy and risk duplicate content. This plugin writes unique product copy from your own notes, using the JCodex API — without you ever creating an OpenAI account.

✅ Product Health Score — click Check for a 0–100 score across content, SEO, images, and conversion, with a checklist of what’s done, weak, or missing.
✅ All Products Scanner — one scan for your catalog: missing titles, descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, images, alt text, FAQs, tags, categories, attributes, SKUs and prices, plus a Health Score for every product.
✅ Brand Voice — set your brand name, industry, target customer, personality and writing style so generations follow your store.
✅ Writes in your site language — follows Settings > General > Site Language, or pick a language under AI Product Manager > Dashboard > Content Language (Swedish, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Urdu and many more).
✅ No API key needed — no OpenAI account, no ChatGPT Plus subscription, no third-party setup.
✅ Lives inside WooCommerce — the panel sits on the product edit screen. Descriptions and short descriptions fill the editor; tags and SEO titles apply when you choose.
✅ Images in one step — describe the shot (a source photo is optional). The result is saved to the Media Library, set as the featured image, with alt text.
✅ Free limits reset monthly — 10 generations per content type on a rolling cycle, not a one-time trial.
✅ Free regenerate — same prompt, tone, length and audience within 15 minutes counts as a free regenerate.
✅ SEO with or without an SEO plugin — writes into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, or SmartCrawl when one of those is active. Otherwise it uses built-in SEO fields on the product.
✅ Built for scale — one product in Free; bulk across published products in Pro.
✅ Written for search — titles, meta descriptions and structured lists, not only filler paragraphs.

🆓 What’s Included in the Free Version

Product Health Score (free, unlimited)
– Click Check on a named product for a score out of 100
– Content check: title, short description, long description length, benefits, FAQ
– SEO check: SEO title, meta description length, focus keyword, keyword usage
– Image check: featured image, alt text, image count
– Conversion check: FAQ, clear benefits, title strength
– Each item is marked done, weak, or missing
– Improve Product with AI is Pro. Free shows the score, the checklist, and a Get Pro link on that button

All Products Scanner (free, unlimited)
– Combines the former Missing Content Scanner and Product Scanner into one tool
– Reports missing or very short titles, missing or very short descriptions, missing short descriptions and FAQs
– Reports missing meta titles (SEO titles) and meta descriptions, with support for Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, SmartCrawl and the plugin’s built-in SEO fields
– Reports missing product images, products with only one image, and missing image alt text
– Reports missing tags, categories, attributes, SKUs and prices, plus duplicate or similar descriptions
– Shows a Health Score for every product, an average score for the store, and lists of the products that need attention
– Filter the scan by product status, product type and category
– Runs in small batches and uses no AI credits

Brand Voice (basic in Free, advanced in Pro)
– Set your brand name, industry, target customer, brand personality and writing style once
– Every AI generation follows that profile when it is enabled
– Pro adds words to use, words to avoid, extra brand rules and Analyze My Existing Store, which learns your writing style from 5–10 of your existing products

Dashboard
– AI Product Manager menu with Dashboard, All Products Scanner and Brand Voice
– Content Language setting (Automatic = site language, or choose a supported language)
– Creator and Bulk show as locked cards with a Get Pro link

Content generation, inside the product editor
– Product descriptions — 10/month. Fills the description editor
– Short descriptions — 10/month. Fills the short description editor
– Product images — 10/month, 4 style presets (ecommerce, lifestyle, luxury, minimal). Describe the shot; uploading a photo is optional
– Feature lists — 10/month (copy from the panel)
– Benefit lists — 10/month (copy from the panel)
– Product tags — 10/month, Apply to Product
– SEO titles — 10/month, then Apply to SEO Fields
– Meta descriptions — 10/month, then Apply to SEO Fields
– Title/name improvement suggestions — 10/month; Use this name fills the product title
– Tones: Sales-focused, SEO Optimized, Luxury, Casual
– Length: Short, Medium, Long
– Audience: General, Men, Women, Kids, B2B
– Free regenerate: same prompt, tone, length and audience within 15 minutes does not use another credit

WooCommerce & SEO integration
– Built for the WooCommerce product edit screen
– Auto-fills the description and short description fields
– Auto-sets the generated image as the featured image (saved when generated)
– Auto-generates image alt text from the product title, or from your image prompt if the product has no title yet
– Saves every generated image to the Media Library
– Writes SEO titles and meta descriptions into the active supported SEO plugin when you click Apply to SEO Fields: Yoast SEO, Rank Math, All in One SEO, SEOPress, The SEO Framework, or SmartCrawl
– Provides built-in SEO title and meta description fields when no supported SEO plugin is active
– Saves the built-in SEO values with the product when you click Update or Publish

No API key required. Free generations refresh every month, so you can keep using the plugin long-term before deciding whether to upgrade.

💎 Pro — Unlimited Generation, Bulk Tools, and More

Everything in Free, plus a license that unlocks unlimited generation and the Pro tools below.

Unlimited generation
– Unlimited descriptions, short descriptions, features, benefits, tags, SEO titles, meta descriptions, images and Pro-only tools while the license is active
– Advanced Brand Voice: words to use, words to avoid and extra brand rules applied to every generation
– Analyze My Existing Store: the AI learns your writing style from 5–10 of your existing products, then “Use my existing brand voice” keeps new content consistent
– Bulk generation also offers a Professional tone

AI Product Creator
– Start from a short brief instead of an existing product (also linked from WooCommerce → All Products)
– Drafts a title, description, short description, tags, attributes, SEO title, meta description, FAQ and SKU
– Sets a price only if you included one in the brief
– Optionally generates a featured image after you save
– Saves the result as a WooCommerce draft. Set the category in the product editor before you publish

Improve an existing product
– Improve Product with AI, on the same Health panel, writes the weak or missing fields in one pass
– You review each field and choose what to apply
– Writes title, description, short description, SEO title, meta description, tags, FAQ, attributes and image alt text (alt only on images that do not already have it)
– Does not invent a category, price, extra photos or a focus keyword
– Leaves the description alone when Elementor, Divi, WPBakery, Beaver Builder, Oxygen or Brizy owns it

Deeper SEO tools
– Unlimited SEO titles and meta descriptions
– Focus keyword and long-tail keyword suggestions (they are not written into your SEO plugin)
– A separate SEO audit for the current product

More product content
– Attribute suggestions you review before saving (custom product attributes, not variations)
– FAQ generator — insert the visible FAQ into the description, then Save Schema so FAQPage JSON-LD can output on the product page
– Specifications table (insert into the description)
– Comparison table (you type the competitor names)
– Rewrite a pasted block: improve SEO, humanize, expand, shorten, or make it more persuasive

Bulk generation
– Description, short description, SEO title, meta description, tags, attributes and image alt text
– Selected products, one category, or published products in the catalog
– Optional overwrite of existing content
– SEO writes go into the active supported SEO plugin, or into this plugin’s fields when none is active
– Export the generated text as CSV
– Does not generate images, features, benefits or FAQs in bulk

Marketing content
– Ad copy: Facebook, Instagram, Google, Pinterest
– Email copy: launch, promotional, sales campaigns
– Video scripts: TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts
– Copy from the panel; it is not posted to those networks for you

Languages
– Same Content Language setting as Free
– Translate tool: paste one block of product HTML and pick German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Urdu, Portuguese, Dutch, Polish, Turkish or Russian
– Does not create or sync WPML, Polylang or TranslatePress translations

What Pro does not include
– No product import from Amazon, AliExpress, Etsy or a supplier URL
– No background removal, image upscaling, mockup generator or bulk image generation
– No CSV product import and no multi-store dashboard
– No extra tones on the product editor (Sales, SEO, Luxury and Casual stay the editor tones)

👉 Upgrade to Pro: https://jcodex.com/plugins/jcodex-ai-product-generator-for-woocommerce/

Who This Plugin Is For

  • WooCommerce store owners who add products regularly and want out of manual copywriting
  • Dropshippers who paste their own product notes and need unique listings fast
  • Print-on-demand stores with hundreds of products that each need individual copy
  • Ecommerce agencies who need a faster product-editor workflow on client stores
  • Retailers rewriting supplier copy they already have, to avoid duplicate-content issues
  • Retailers who want better search visibility without hiring a copywriter

How It Works

  1. Open any product in WooCommerce
  2. Find the AI Product Manager panel near the top of the product editor. Click Check for the Product Health Score and checklist
  3. Type a few product details in the prompt. Use the tabs for Description, Short Desc, Features, Benefits, Tags, SEO and Name Ideas. The image tool is the AI Product Image box in the sidebar
  4. In Pro, use Improve Product with AI on the Health panel to draft the flagged fields, then tick what to apply
  5. Descriptions and short descriptions fill the editor. Click Apply for tags and SEO. Generated images are set as the featured image straight away. Review, then Update or Publish
  6. For the whole catalog, open AI Product Manager > All Products Scanner
  7. For brand tone, open AI Product Manager > Brand Voice. For language, open Dashboard > Content Language

The plugin connects to the JCodex API, which runs generation on the backend. No OpenAI account, ChatGPT subscription, or external API key on your site.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JCodex API at https://jcodex.com/wp-json/apg/v1. Generation is processed there so you do not need your own OpenAI key.

Requests are sent when:

  1. A logged-in shop manager or editor clicks Generate (or another generate action) in wp-admin. The payload is the prompt built from product content you typed or already saved, plus the public site URL. If a Pro license is active, the license key is sent so unlimited usage can be verified.
  2. The product editor or Dashboard loads on the free plan, at most once every 6 hours, the plugin asks /usage for remaining monthly counts so the “X left” labels stay accurate. That call also registers the site on first use (public site URL, a random install ID stored in your database, plugin version, and a short-lived domain challenge).
  3. Domain verification uses a public REST route on your site: GET /wp-json/jcodex-apg/v1/verify. It returns only a temporary random challenge string. It does not expose products, users, or settings.

No customer personal data, order data, or visitor analytics are collected or transmitted.

  • JCodex Terms of Use: https://jcodex.com/terms/
  • JCodex Privacy Policy: https://jcodex.com/privacy/

JCodex may use OpenAI on its backend. Their policies apply to prompt processing:
– OpenAI Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • WooCommerce, installed and active
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

Third-party resources

DM Sans is bundled under the SIL Open Font License 1.1. The license text is in assets/fonts/OFL.txt.
sections.installation:
1. Make sure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Search for All in One – AI Product Manager for WooCommerce and click Install Now.
  4. Click Activate. You will be taken to the plugin Dashboard.
  5. Open any product under Products > Add New, or edit an existing one. Give it a name, then click Check if you want a Health Score.
  6. Find the AI Product Manager panel near the top of the product editor, and AI Product Image in the sidebar.
  7. Enter a few product details, click Generate, and review the result.
sections.faq:
Is this a WooCommerce-specific tool, or a general AI writing plugin?

It’s built specifically for WooCommerce. The tools live on the product edit screen and write into WooCommerce fields: description, short description, tags, and featured image.

Do I need an API key, OpenAI account, or ChatGPT subscription?

No. The plugin connects to the JCodex API. No OpenAI account, ChatGPT Plus subscription, or third-party API key is required on your site.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active. The generator panel only appears on WooCommerce product edit pages.

Is there a free plan?

Yes. Each month you get 10 descriptions, 10 short descriptions, 10 images, 10 SEO titles, 10 meta descriptions, 10 feature lists, 10 benefit lists, 10 tag sets, and 10 name-suggestion runs. Each type has its own allowance. Product Health and the All Products Scanner are unlimited and use no credits.

What happens after I use my free generations for the month?

You’ll be prompted to upgrade to Pro for unlimited generation. Your free allowance for each content type refreshes on a rolling 30-day cycle either way. Anything already generated stays in place.

Can I regenerate a result without using another credit?

Yes. Click Generate again with the same prompt, tone, length and audience within 15 minutes. That window can cover more than one identical retry.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO?

Yes. It also writes into SEOPress, The SEO Framework and SmartCrawl when one of those is the active SEO plugin. Click Apply to SEO Fields after you generate. If no supported SEO plugin is active, values go into this plugin’s own SEO fields.

What happens if I do not have an SEO plugin installed?

You can still generate and save an SEO title and meta description. In the product editor those values are saved when you Update or Publish. Bulk generation (Pro) saves them immediately. On the product page the plugin can output that title and meta description when no supported SEO plugin is active.

Where are the built-in SEO title and meta description stored?

They are stored with the WooCommerce product and remain available when you edit the product again.

Does the image generator add alt text automatically?

Yes. Every generated image gets alt text from the product title, or from your image prompt if the product has no title yet.

Do I need to upload a photo to generate an image?

No. Describe the shot in the image box. Uploading a product photo is optional and helps the AI match your product.

How do I generate content for my entire catalog in bulk?

Upgrade to Pro. Bulk can write descriptions, short descriptions, SEO titles, meta descriptions, tags, attributes and image alt text for selected products, a category, or published products in the catalog. It does not generate images, features, benefits or FAQs in bulk.

Can I control the writing style and tone?

Yes. The product editor includes Sales-focused, SEO Optimized, Luxury and Casual, plus Short/Medium/Long length and audience (General, Men, Women, Kids, B2B). Pro bulk generation also includes Professional. Rewrite (Pro) can make a pasted block more persuasive.

Does it support multiple languages?

Yes. Generated content follows your WordPress site language, or the language you pick under AI Product Manager > Dashboard > Content Language. The product editor shows the active language with a Change language link. Pro can translate one pasted HTML block into another language. It does not create or sync WPML or Polylang translations.

Why is the content generated in English on my non-English site?

Save Site Language under Settings > General, or pick the language under Dashboard > Content Language. The plugin’s own buttons may still show English until a translation for your language is available.

Where are generated images saved?

To the Media Library, set as the featured image, with alt text applied.

Will this affect my store’s speed or frontend performance?

API calls run in wp-admin when you generate, and a short usage request can run when a shop manager opens the product editor or Dashboard (at most once every 6 hours on the free plan). Storefront pages do not call the JCodex API. If no supported SEO plugin is active, the plugin may output a saved SEO title and meta description on singular product pages. Pro may output FAQ JSON-LD there when the questions are also visible in the description.

Does it work with the Block Editor and Classic Editor?

The panel is built for the WooCommerce product edit screen (the standard product editor). Descriptions are written into that editor’s content and short-description fields.

Can I edit AI-generated content before publishing?

Yes. Descriptions and short descriptions land in the editor for you to change. Tags and SEO fields apply when you click Apply. Generated images and Pro bulk writes are saved when those actions run. Always review before you leave the product.

Does it work with any WooCommerce theme?

Yes. The plugin operates in wp-admin on the product editor. Storefront output is limited to optional SEO tags and, in Pro, FAQ JSON-LD on the product page.

Is this plugin GDPR friendly?

The plugin transmits your public site URL, an install identifier, and the product-content prompts you submit. No customer personal data, orders, or visitor analytics are collected or transmitted. Review the JCodex Privacy Policy and third-party AI provider policies.

Can I import products from Amazon or AliExpress?

No. The plugin does not fetch a product from a URL. In Pro you can paste your own brief into AI Product Creator and save a draft, or rewrite text you already have.

Can it generate marketing copy for social media and email?

Yes, in Pro: Facebook ads, Instagram posts, Google ads, Pinterest, launch and promo emails, TikTok / Reels / Shorts scripts. You copy the text out of the panel.

What is the Product Health Score?

A free, per-product score out of 100. Click Check (it does not run by itself on an empty draft). The checklist covers title, short description, description length, benefits and FAQ; SEO title, meta description length, focus keyword and keyword usage; featured image, alt text and image count; and conversion checks. Focus keyword is read from a supported SEO plugin when one is set. The plugin does not invent a focus keyword. Improve Product with AI is Pro.

Is the Product Health Score free?

Yes. Check as many products as you like. It uses no monthly generation credits.

Can the plugin scan my whole catalog for missing content?

Yes. The All Products Scanner is free and unlimited. It reports missing titles, descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, images, alt text, FAQs, tags, categories, attributes, SKUs or prices, plus short or duplicate descriptions, with a Health Score for every product.

What happened to the Product Scanner and the Missing Content Scanner?

They were merged into the All Products Scanner. Old Product Scanner links open the new page.

What is AI Product Creator?

A Pro page under AI Product Manager, also linked from the products list. You enter a short brief. The AI drafts a title, description, short description, tags, attributes, SEO title, meta description, FAQ and SKU. You review it, optionally add an image, then save a WooCommerce draft. It does not assign a category and it does not invent a price unless the brief includes one.

What is Brand Voice?

Brand name, industry, target customer, personality and writing style. Once saved and enabled, generations follow it. Pro adds words to use and avoid, extra rules, and Analyze My Existing Store.
sections.changelog:
1.2.6

  • Product Health Score is now always free: Re-check no longer uses the monthly text allowance
  • Unified the admin look: DM Sans (self-hosted), one blue/indigo color scheme, and consistent heading sizes
  • Removed star icons from Generate buttons
  • Pro: AI Product Creator no longer assigns categories; set them in the product editor
  • Pro: AI Product Creator preview is a review step — Generate listing does not create a product until you save the draft
  • Licensed Pro stores no longer see the free-plan monthly-limit note in the product editor

1.2.5

  • New settings page to manage plugin options
  • Security improvements

1.2.4

  • Merged the Missing Content Scanner and the Product Scanner into one All Products Scanner: scans all products in small batches and reports missing or very short titles, descriptions and short descriptions, meta titles, meta descriptions, images, image ALT text, FAQs, tags, categories, attributes, SKUs and prices, plus duplicate/similar descriptions, with a Health Score and a product list for each issue
  • The All Products Scanner can be filtered by product status, product type and category
  • Added Brand Voice: define your brand name, industry, target customer, personality and writing style, and every AI generation follows it (advanced options are in Pro)
  • Added a Content Language setting (AI Product Manager > Dashboard, with a Change language link inside the product editor panel): leave it on Automatic to follow the WordPress site language or choose any supported language for AI-generated content
  • AI content now follows the WordPress site language: descriptions, short descriptions, features, benefits, tags, SEO titles, meta descriptions, name suggestions and Product Health insights are generated in the language set under Settings > General > Site Language (developers can override it with the jcodex_apgwco_content_language filter)
  • Added a main “AI Product Manager” menu with a Dashboard page and submenus for the All Products Scanner and Brand Voice
  • Added a Settings link on the Plugins page that opens the plugin Dashboard
  • AI Product Image: the description field is now required and the source photo upload is now optional — you can generate an image from a text description alone, or upload a photo for the AI to match
  • Product Health now scores the checklist shown in the editor: title, short description, description length, benefits, FAQ, SEO title, meta description length, focus keyword, keyword usage, featured image, alt text, image count, and conversion checks for FAQ, benefits and title strength
  • Pro: Improve Product with AI is back on the Health panel and reviews the same fields before applying them, including attributes and image alt text
  • Pro bulk generation keeps HTML in descriptions, writes attributes and image alt text, and sends SEO titles and meta descriptions through the active SEO plugin
  • Pro: AI Product Creator drafts a new product from a short brief and saves it as a WooCommerce draft
  • Removed the non-functional “Fix with AI” button from the Product Health results
  • Added built-in SEO title and meta description fields for stores that do not have a supported SEO plugin installed
  • Generated SEO titles and meta descriptions can now be saved with the product through the plugin’s own SEO fields
  • Updated the SEO workflow so it can use supported SEO plugins when available and the plugin’s built-in fields when they are not

1.2.3

  • Fix a UX issue with generate buttons

1.2.2

  • Added the Product Health Score — a free, per-product score out of 100 across content, SEO, images, and conversion, with a done/weak/missing checklist
  • Added Improve Product with AI — one-click generation for whatever the Health Score flags
  • Added the Missing Content Scanner — a free, catalog-wide scan for missing descriptions, meta descriptions, images, alt text, and FAQs, plus short or duplicate descriptions
  • Added Fix with AI on the scanner results to jump straight into generation

1.2.1

  • Free generations now refresh every month instead of a one-time lifetime cap
  • Added free regenerate — re-click Generate with the same inputs within 15 minutes at no extra credit cost
  • Generated images now get automatic alt text (from product title or image prompt)
  • SEO titles and meta descriptions now write directly into Yoast SEO, Rank Math, or All in One SEO when active
  • Added a usage-cycle note inside the panel so users know when free monthly limits reset

1.2.0

  • Added limited product description, short description, and image generation
  • Added feature list, benefit list, and tag generators
  • Added AI panel inside the WooCommerce product editor
  • Auto-fill for description, short description, and featured image
  • Added basic SEO title and meta description generation
  • Added product name improvement suggestions
  • Free tier: 10 descriptions, 10 short descriptions, 10 images, 10 SEO titles — no API key required

1.0.0

  • Initial release
  • Product description and image generation inside the WooCommerce product editor
  • Auto-save generated images to the Media Library
  • Auto-fill description and short description fields, auto-set featured image
  • Basic SEO title and meta description generation
  • Tags, features, and benefits generators
  • Freemium usage limits for free-tier users

How It Works

  1. Open any product in WooCommerce
  2. Find the AI Product Manager panel near the top of the product editor. Click Check for the Product Health Score and checklist
  3. Type a few product details in the prompt. Use the tabs for Description, Short Desc, Features, Benefits, Tags, SEO and Name Ideas. The image tool is the AI Product Image box in the sidebar
  4. In Pro, use Improve Product with AI on the Health panel to draft the flagged fields, then tick what to apply
  5. Descriptions and short descriptions fill the editor. Click Apply for tags and SEO. Generated images are set as the featured image straight away. Review, then Update or Publish
  6. For the whole catalog, open AI Product Manager > All Products Scanner
  7. For brand tone, open AI Product Manager > Brand Voice. For language, open Dashboard > Content Language

The plugin connects to the JCodex API, which runs generation on the backend. No OpenAI account, ChatGPT subscription, or external API key on your site.

External Services

This plugin connects to the JCodex API at https://jcodex.com/wp-json/apg/v1. Generation is processed there so you do not need your own OpenAI key.

Requests are sent when:

  1. A logged-in shop manager or editor clicks Generate (or another generate action) in wp-admin. The payload is the prompt built from product content you typed or already saved, plus the public site URL. If a Pro license is active, the license key is sent so unlimited usage can be verified.
  2. The product editor or Dashboard loads on the free plan, at most once every 6 hours, the plugin asks /usage for remaining monthly counts so the “X left” labels stay accurate. That call also registers the site on first use (public site URL, a random install ID stored in your database, plugin version, and a short-lived domain challenge).
  3. Domain verification uses a public REST route on your site: GET /wp-json/jcodex-apg/v1/verify. It returns only a temporary random challenge string. It does not expose products, users, or settings.

No customer personal data, order data, or visitor analytics are collected or transmitted.

  • JCodex Terms of Use: https://jcodex.com/terms/
  • JCodex Privacy Policy: https://jcodex.com/privacy/

JCodex may use OpenAI on its backend. Their policies apply to prompt processing:
– OpenAI Terms: https://openai.com/policies/terms-of-use/
